episodes.title: The woman who challenged Weinstein: Why #MeToo isn't over
episodes.description: Zelda Perkins was the first woman to break a Harvey Weinstein-related NDA in 2017, signed almost 20 years earlier with the disgraced film producer. Recently, we've seen Russell Brand convicted of rape and sexual assault, and David Walliams face allegations of sexual misconduct, which he denies. So are we on the cusp of another #Me Too movement? And how far has society come since 2017? Zelda's group, Can't Buy My Silence, campaigns against NDAs being used in legal contracts or settlements to stop people from speaking out against their employers. So is it now time to ban NDAs altogether? In an emotional interview, Cathy and Zelda reflect on the legacy of the Me Too movement, and hear from comedian Lucy Beaumont, Labour MP Jess Phillips and former deputy Labour leader Harriet Harman.
